ladder: Beef > Japanese Wagyu (by prefecture) > American & Australian Wagyu > Poultry > Seafood > Pork (by breed) > Game & Specialty > Sides & Pantry
facets: species and programme; wagyu origin; pork breed; pasture-raised; grass-fed; organic
quality_markers: breed; feeding (pasture, grass-fed); origin prefecture; grade (A5/BMS)
quality_signals: A5 and BMS wagyu grades; Heritage, Ibérico, Mangalitsa pork breeds
notes: Species-led top level; wagyu gets own sections by origin; breed labels for pork; no filter list seen.

ladder: Fleisch Wurst und Ersatz > Wurst > product type (Würste, Salami, Geflügelwurst, Roher Schinken, Schinken, Speck, Leberwurst, Mettwurst ...)
facets: Produkteigenschaften (Bio; Vegan; Fair; Vegetarisch; Glutenfrei; Laktosefrei); Produktkategorie; Hersteller; Sortierung (Kalorien; Preis; alphabetisch)
notes: Third-party mirror of REWE tree. About 89 named product types, many regional (Weißwurst, Lyoner, Landjäger); brand is a filter not a level.

ladder: Grade (Select > Choice > Prime) > cut (ribeye, T-bone, porterhouse)
quality_markers: marbling; animal age (maturity); grade then cut; taste and budget
quality_signals: USDA Prime; USDA Choice; USDA Select
notes: Warns wagyu label does not mean top grade; Prime often only at specialty counters.

ladder: Prime > Choice > Select > Standard/Commercial/Utility/Cutter/Canner
quality_markers: marbling; yield; tenderness; juiciness; flavour
quality_signals: USDA grade shield (voluntary, paid, set by USDA); JMGA for wagyu
notes: Grading is voluntary; the shield on label; Prime ~2-3% and Choice most common per other guides.

source_name: Crowd Cow wagyu grading guide (JP system)
ladder: Yield letter A-C > quality number 1-5 > BMS 1-12
quality_markers: marbling (BMS); meat colour and brightness; firmness and texture; fat colour and quality (lowest of four sets the grade)
quality_signals: JMGA grade A5/A4/A3; BMS 1-12; A5 = BMS 8-12
notes: Japan Meat Grading Association grades each carcass; quality number is lowest of four sub-scores, not an average.

source_name: Reluctant Gourmet jamon iberico de bellota guide (ES)
ladder: Black label > red > green > white
quality_markers: breed; diet (acorns); time (aged 36 months or more); origin (dehesa regions Jabugo, Guijuelo, Los Pedroches)
quality_signals: Ibérico colour labels (black 100% Ibérico bellota; red; green cebo de campo; white cebo); pata negra not official
notes: Spanish ham sold by colour label combining breed, feeding and cure; no body named on page.

ladder: Seafood > wild-caught fish / sustainably farmed fish / shellfish / sashimi-grade
quality_markers: wild-caught or farmed; sashimi-grade
quality_signals: sashimi-grade (seller term)
notes: Seafood is one top-level entry among species groups; sub-split by wild vs farmed and shellfish; no filters listed.

source_name: Woolworths South Africa how to shop for fish (ZA)
ladder: Touch > sight > smell; fish vs shellfish
quality_markers: firmness and rigor; shiny look; clear bulging eyes; faint seawater smell; shellfish shell tight to flesh
notes: Freshness is the quality test; rigor mortis called most accurate sign; squid is an exception. No certification named.

ladder: Best Choice (green) > Certified (blue) > Good Alternative (yellow) > Avoid (red)
quality_markers: fishing or farming impact on ecosystem; gear and farming method; management
quality_signals: Seafood Watch Best Choice / Good Alternative / Avoid (Monterey Bay Aquarium); contaminant alerts shown separately
notes: Sustainability rating by an aquarium NGO; guides updated twice a year; mercury alerts separate.

ladder: Fishery assessment > chain of custody > blue label
quality_markers: healthy fish stocks; minimal environmental impact; effective management
quality_signals: MSC blue label (Fisheries Standard and Chain of Custody; independent auditors; annual audit, reassessment every five years)
notes: Wild-capture only; farmed operations excluded; label needs every company in chain certified.

ladder: Shop Caviar (All > Ossetra > Beluga > Imperial) > Shop By Experience (beginners, best-selling, gifts) > Serve With Caviar
facets: species (Beluga; Osetra; Sevruga; Kaluga; Paddlefish); salt level (malossol)
quality_markers: egg size; colour; maturity; salt level; personal taste and price
quality_signals: caviar grading by egg size colour maturity (no named body)
notes: Sturgeon species lead; only sturgeon eggs are caviar; other fish eggs are roe; shop adds a use/occasion route.

source_name: Food Republic sushi grade vs sashimi grade (US)
ladder: Seller trust > parasite treatment (freezing) > cut (fatty tuna, salmon belly)
quality_markers: seller reputation; handling; freezing for parasites
quality_signals: sushi/sashimi grade is a marketing term with no standard (FDA gives raw-fish guidance only)
notes: Fish has no USDA-style grading; label worth only the fishmonger behind it.

source_name: Syndicat PDO dairy products France what is a PDO (FR)
ladder: Milk production > processing > maturing (all in the designated area)
quality_markers: origin of milk; traditional technique per public specification; maturing in area; sensory profile checked by tasting commission
quality_signals: PDO/AOP (INAO and European Commission; accredited certifying bodies, COFRAC); 46 French PDO cheeses, 3 butters, 2 creams
notes: Origin-protected names are the main cheese quality mark in Europe; also covers butter and cream.

ladder: Grade AA > A > B; then housing labels (cage-free; free-range; pasture-raised; organic)
quality_markers: shell, white and yolk quality (lowest part sets grade); hen housing; feed; outdoor access
quality_signals: USDA grades AA/A/B; USDA free-range, cage-free and organic definitions; pasture-raised unregulated
notes: Egg quality is grade plus housing system; shell colour is only breed.

source_name: Gourmet Traveller how to choose great cheese (AU)
ladder: Rind > paste > taste > smell > ask the cheesemonger
quality_markers: natural rind not plastic or wax; paste colour and texture; flavour complexity and length; no ammonia; single-farm or herd provenance; pasture-fed
notes: Cheese described by rind style, milk animal, texture and named style; no formal classification; terroir of a single farm valued.

source_name: Stiftung Warentest test.de cheese Q and A (DE)
ladder: Frischkäse > Weichkäse > Schnitt- und Hartkäse
quality_markers: smooth rind without wrinkles; no odd holes; soft cheese yields to finger; harmless vs wild mould; fat in dry matter
quality_signals: Bio label; Analogkäse naming rule; Fett i. Tr. declaration
notes: German consumer-test body groups by firmness and ripening; imitation cheese must not be called cheese.

ladder: Categories > Housebrand Dairy, Chilled & Eggs
notes: Only top-level category names seen; dairy, chilled and eggs are one department; sort by newest or popularity.

ladder: Departments: Fruits & Vegetables > Meat & Seafood > Dairy, Eggs & Fridge > Pantry > Bakery > Freezer > Drinks
notes: Catalogue only (no online ordering); dairy and eggs sit together with fridge items; ALDI states share of Australian-sourced dairy.

source_name: Ethical Consumer plant milk shopping guide (UK)
ladder: Company ownership > base ingredient (oat, pea, soya, almond) > packaging > other ethics
quality_markers: ownership (vegan company); base ingredient impact; packaging; workers, tax, climate
quality_signals: Ethical Consumer score out of 100 and category ratings; Best Buy list (subscription only)
notes: For plant milks the guide ranks by company ethics and ingredient impact, not taste; ratings set by an NGO research team.

ladder: Fresh Produce > Fresh Fruit / Fresh Vegetables / Party Trays
facets: Brands (Del Monte; Dole; Driscoll's; Sunkist; Taylor Farms ...); Nutrition (Organic; Vegan; Kosher; Fat Free; Gluten Free; Sugar Free)
notes: Fruit and vegetables are the two sub-levels; brand and organic are filters not levels.

source_name: UNECE fruit and vegetables standards via FAO (intl)
ladder: Extra > Class I > Class II
quality_markers: intact and sound; clean; no foreign smell or taste; ripe enough to travel; typical of variety; defects and sizing by class
quality_signals: Extra, Class I, Class II (UNECE Working Party on perishable foodstuffs; applied by public authorities); some products use fewer classes
notes: Extra means no or trivial defects and strictest sizing; cherries, onions, lettuces and early potatoes use fewer classes.

source_name: Whats Cooking America vegetable buying guide (US)
ladder: General rules (freshness, maturity, careful handling) > vegetable by vegetable A-Z
quality_markers: bright lively colour and crispness; mature not green; firm and heavy for size; no bruising, mould, yellowing
notes: Quality tested per species by look, firmness and weight for size; no grouping of vegetables beyond the A-Z list.

source_name: Mental Floss how to choose 13 fruits and vegetables (US)
ladder: Species by species
quality_markers: firmness; colour; smell at stem end; heavy for size; ripeness cues (ground spot, sugar spots, stem end)
notes: Each fruit has its own ripeness test; smell and firmness recur.

ladder: Organic veg boxes > Zero packaging boxes > Summer fruits (seasonal) > Recipes > A-Z of fruit and veg > Ethics and ethos
quality_markers: seasonal; organic; packaging
notes: Leads with boxes and season rather than species; A-Z of fruit and veg as a reference list; 100% organic range is the house claim.

ladder: Black label (100% ibérico de bellota) > red (bellota, 50-75%) > green (cebo de campo) > white (cebo)
quality_markers: breed percentage; diet (acorn or grain); free-range; cure length (36 or 24 months); dehesa origin
quality_signals: Colour label system (since 2014); pata negra only for black label; DOP Guijuelo, Jabugo, Dehesa de Extremadura, Los Pedroches
notes: Same labels apply to paleta and loin; page warns much ham sold as ibérico may not be genuine.

ladder: Bronze > Silver > Gold > table Super Gold (98) > final 16 > World Champion
quality_markers: visual appearance; aroma; flavour; mouthfeel (scored out of 35)
quality_signals: World Cheese Awards medals and Super Gold (Guild of Fine Food)
notes: Blind-style tasting by judge tables; page does not state how entries are split into categories.

ladder: Brüh-/Knetkäse > Hartkäse > Edelpilzkäse > Frischkäse > Schnittkäse
facets: fat content; ripening; milk type (cow, sheep, goat, buffalo); texture; mould type
notes: Five groups by make and firmness; milk animal and ripening are attributes within the group.

source_name: Farm Sanctuary guide to plant-based milks (US)
ladder: Taste > flavour > texture > intended use > cost
quality_markers: taste preference; flavour; thickness; use (coffee, frothing, cooking); cost
notes: Plant milks chosen by base (soy, oat, pea, cashew, almond, coconut, hemp) and use; no grades.

ladder: Yearbook listing > inventories by category (garden seed; fruit, nut and berry)
quality_markers: heirloom variety with recorded history
notes: About 13,000 members swap heirloom seeds; identity is the heirloom variety and its history, not a country or maker.

ladder: Fruit type (apples, pears, plums, cherries ...) > filtered variety list
facets: Using (picking season; keeping time; flavour style; food uses); Growing; Climate; Identification (origin; flesh colour; fruit size; awards such as RHS AGM); disease resistance
quality_markers: flavour quality and style; keeping time; picking season; food use (fresh, culinary, cider, juice)
quality_signals: RHS AGM award
notes: Cultivar is the unit; 793 apple-related varieties filterable by taste, season, keeping and use.

ladder: Meat & Seafood > Beef / Chicken / Seafood / Frozen Meats / Pork / Lamb / Turkey / Sausage / Hot Dogs / Bacon / Packaged and Sliced Deli Meats / Wild Game / Meat Substitutes
quality_markers: no-antibiotics; grass fed and finished; pasture raised; organic; humane; uncured
quality_signals: USDA Organic; Certified Humane; GAP Certified; No Antibiotics Ever; Wild-Caught
notes: Species first; production claims appear on labels rather than as levels; beef page lists no cut sub-menu.

ladder: Hard > Soft > Blue > Goat's and Sheep's > Raclette and fondue > Selections > Subscriptions
quality_markers: traditionally made; sourced from named producers; matured in own cellars; flavour
notes: Specialist leads with firmness/type; maker relationship and own maturing are the quality story.

ladder: Shop Cheese (Brand / Taste / Type / Characteristics) > Gifts (type, price, occasion) > Occasions
facets: Type (Hard; Blue; Soft; Goat's; Sheep's); Taste (Creamy; Cheddar'esque; Captivating); Characteristics (Award Winners; Traditional Clothbound); price bands
quality_markers: farmhouse and handmade; family-herd milk; finish (clothbound)
quality_signals: Great Taste Award (two-star)
notes: One shop offers four routes in: maker brand, taste, type and characteristic; award winners as a collection.
